source_instruction: Disk space monitoring check triggered quota warning
explanation: AGAPE detected disk space usage approaching quota threshold in file fallback mode. Current available space (850MB) is below warning threshold (1GB). This violation occurs because system resource limits are being approached, which could impact AGAPE's ability to continue file-based persistence operations.
suggested_fix: 1) Clean up old event/WHY files older than 30 days, 2) Archive completed events to separate storage, 3) Increase disk quota if available, 4) Monitor disk space usage more frequently
impact_assessment: Moderate - File fallback operations may become impaired if disk space exhausted
prevention_measures: Implement automatic cleanup routine for old files, set up disk space monitoring alerts, establish archival process for historical data
learning_transfer_notes: Add disk space monitoring to AGAPE startup checklist, include quota management in agent training materials
